initial_configurations.rationale: Unequal region lengths and independently drawn disorder test transferability of the allocation trap
Even ground-sector allocation in three spatially random regions, not an odd-case parity flip alone
Inequivalent soft boundary islands with weak contacts and a stiffer interior
Four quartic and spring regions test ground-sector restoration across physically different interfaces
Correlated mass and spring disorder at a different cap and site-dependent oscillator basis
Dimerized internal springs and two weak contacts change the entanglement allocation pattern
Odd excitation in four nonidentical quartic regions at bond 16
Three separated low-mass islands with positive-mass bridges and inequivalent contacts
Weakly disordered crossover coordinate selected from the measured finite-basis parity-response bracket
Uniform odd-sector crossover control at a larger cap, without changing the advertised size domain
Nonzero smooth competing field removes exact parity blocking while retaining a weak collective response
Unequal tilted regions with distinct quartics test unrestricted variational quality, not a parity-only implementation
